The '''Moisture Farmers of Tatooine''' organization was formed by [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], one moisture farmer, [[Ardon Crell]], represented the others in paying the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] for protection from the planet's [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

In 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], during Crell's work representing the Moisture Farmers of Tatooine, he was in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on Tatooine when [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|several]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|arrived]] with the intent of freeing Jabba's [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. The events that followed led to the Alliance operatives [[Death/Legends|killing]] Jabba and [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|destroying]] the Hutt's [[Luxury-class sail barge|luxury sail barge]] [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] over the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] while Crell was aboard.

==History==
[[File:Ardon1.png|thumb|left|154px|Ardon Crell (far left) was the Moisture Farmers of Tatooine's representative in Jabba the Hutt's palace.]]
A group of [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] formed the Moisture Farmers of Tatooine organization on the [[Tatooine/Legends|eponymous]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] by the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Local 253]] was one of the Moisture Farmers of Tatooine's sectors, and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ardon Crell]] had joined the organization by<ref name="BtM" /> [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the events of {{Film|VI}} take place in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> representing local 253<ref name="CCG" /> and having been elected by his peers to serve as a liaison between local 253 and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. The [[Water/Legends|moisture]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] agreed to pay Jabba in exchange for the crime lord arranging their protection from Tatooine's indigenous [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="BtM" />

In 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Crell was in Jabba's [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] with the responsibility of collecting and delivering the moisture farmers' protection money<ref name="BtM" /> when [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|several]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|arrived]] intending to rescue their ally, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] in the palace. The rescue attempt led to Jabba sentencing Solo, along with his companions [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], to [[Death/Legends|death]] over the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]. However, the captives [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|fought back]], killing Jabba and destroying the Hutt's [[Luxury-class sail barge|luxury sail barge]] [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] with Crell aboard.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Moisture Farmers of Tatooine organization first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], with one of their active members, Ardon Crell, onscreen in the film's Jabba's Palace and ''Khetanna'' scenes.<ref name="RotJ" /> The organization's name was first established by Ardon Crell's card in the [[1998]] ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" />
